mentions.name: atom
mentions.description: A work-in-progress relational/logic programming language inspired by Datalog and Bruce MacLennan's relational programming work. It adopts the open-world assumption to support missing values and heterogeneous data while enforcing data integrity, and aims to provide strong correctness guarantees in the LLM era.
mentions.problem: Logic languages are expected to become increasingly important in the LLM era to provide strong correctness guarantees and serve as a source of reinforcement learning; relational data models offer advantages over the object-oriented view.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a new relational / logic language inspired by datalog and Bruce MacLennan's pioneering work on relational programming, but adopting the open-world assumption to allow missing values / heterogeneous data and enforce data integrity.
